_prototype_warning: All percentages in this file are configurable prototype commercial defaults authored for this milestone (EAP.M4), grounded loosely in PRICING-RULES.md section 4's illustrative contingency guidance and section 3's worked 30% margin example. They are NOT approved commercial policy and must be reviewed by business stakeholders before any real-world quote is generated from them.

recommended.scenario_description: Balanced commercial position: moderate contingency for typical delivery uncertainty, target margin aligned to the configured commercial baseline.

competitive.scenario_description: Lower contingency and target margin than Recommended, for price-sensitive situations. Always requires human review before approval.

conservative.scenario_description: Higher contingency and target margin than Recommended, for engagements with significant uncertainty, dependencies, or delivery risk.

custom.scenario_description: User-defined contingency and target margin, starting from the Recommended scenario's values. Requires an explanation when materially different from Recommended.
